conclusion: Do not promote the 160-step model: exact-plan and context scores regressed despite better meaning preservation.
limitations: Both pilots use the small development fixture set, not the untouched frozen release holdout.
Training data and iteration count changed together; this is not a controlled ablation.
Safety improvement over historical predictions comes from the original-Unicode runtime guard; benign newlines, tabs and joining scalars also fall back unchanged.
Independent frozen-suite approval is withheld for missing safe output variants and native malformed-plan probe evidence.
Neither model meets release quality. M5 Pro execution is not physical 8 GB M1 latency/memory evidence.
Full recognition/Cleanup network-deny and hosted signed-download capture still require external artifacts.
